bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cd /home/admin1/server-core
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 7fede271a9459b998935e1ae9995d7feba27d9c5
test "$(git hash-object scripts/servercore_bounded_host_receiver.py)" = 99b7aee32962348085f6d4051f6c56ee929c8b28
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' server-core-bounded-host)" = true
img=gace-server-core-bounded-host:hostsha-7fede271
docker build --pull=false -q -f Dockerfile.bounded-host -t "$img" . >/dev/null
docker run --rm --user 65532:65532 --entrypoint python3 "$img" -c 'from pathlib import Path; s=Path("/app/scripts/servercore_bounded_host_receiver.py").read_text(); assert "replay_only" in s and "HOST_COMMAND_REPLAY_MISSING" in s'
printf 'RECEIVER_IMAGE_BUILD_PASS\n'
